valueunit_analysis.finding: Unit is self-recursive via CombiUnit of Unit * Operator * Unit. Sub-types (CountUnit, MassUnit, etc.) don't reference Unit - only contain BigRational. namespace rec makes all 'and' keywords on sub-types redundant. For Types.fs split, 10 static member operator overloads (type ValueUnit with) need to become let inline functions to avoid optional-extension pitfalls.
options: minimal: remove and from sub-types (keep namespace rec)
partial split: sub-types to Types.fs, Unit+ValueUnit stay
full split: everything to Types.fs + convert operators to let inline
